title: Neon stadium
subtitle: supersaw & drums
notes: Neon Stadium: an original eight-bar, 128 BPM arena-rave signal demo.
The SPU only schedules a generic g.* kernel. Guest instructions implement
seven polyBLEP-corrected detuned saws, gated bass/chords, avalanche noise,
kick, snare, offbeat hats, envelopes, ducking, and stereo float stores.
The CPU paints a small indexed visual and animates one scanline at vblank.
excerpt:
.profile spu-1
.equ SPU, 0xf6000
.equ VIDEO, 0xf5000
.equ FB, 0x10000
.equ PAL, 0x20000
.equ AUDIO, 0x24000
.entry start
start:
    li r12, SPU
    li r1, sound_kernel
    sw r1, 0x40(r12)
    li r1, sound_kernel_end-sound_kernel
    sw r1, 0x44(r12)
    li r1, 128
    sw r1, 0x48(r12)
    li r1, 2
    sw r1, 0x4c(r12)
    li r1, AUDIO
